title: Add Tamil/English voice search to the search bar with a microphone button

requirements.text: Add a microphone button inside the main search input UI so users can trigger voice search on mobile browsers. This must be integrated into the existing Home page natural-language search input (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx) without requiring login.

quotes: Add a microphone button inside the search box.

acceptanceCriteria: Home page search input renders a tap-friendly microphone icon button positioned inside the input field (not outside the search area).
The microphone button is visible and usable on mobile browsers.
No login is required to see or use the microphone button.

requirements.text: Implement speech-to-text voice recognition so that when the microphone button is tapped: (1) speech recognition starts, (2) speech is converted to text, (3) the recognized text auto-fills the search input, and (4) search is automatically triggered using the existing search submit/navigation behavior.

quotes:
When tapped:
Start speech recognition
Convert speech to text
Auto-fill the search input
Automatically trigger search

acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the microphone starts speech recognition and captures the user’s voice.
After recognition returns a final transcript, the search input value is replaced/filled with the recognized transcript.
After filling the input, the app automatically triggers the same search flow as pressing the existing Search submit (i.e., navigates to /search with search: { q: <recognized text> } on Home page).
The implementation does not crash the page if speech recognition errors, is cancelled, or returns an empty transcript.

requirements.text: Support both Tamil and English speech recognition for voice search. Configure recognition to work for typical user utterances in Tamil/English mixed queries (examples include: "tindivanam plumber irukana", "painting work venum", "AC repair near me", "samayal aunty venum nalaiku").
acceptanceCriteria: Voice search recognizes English speech and produces an English transcript for common queries like "AC repair near me".

Voice search recognizes Tamil (and Tamil transliteration/mixed) speech and produces a transcript usable by the existing fuzzy/natural-language matching for queries like "painting work venum" and "tindivanam plumber irukana".
The recognized transcript is passed through the existing search pipeline unchanged except for normal trimming (no forced translation and no login).

requirements.text: Provide a safe fallback behavior on browsers that do not support Web Speech API speech recognition: disable or hide the microphone button and (optionally) show a simple English-only message indicating voice search is not supported on this browser, without affecting normal typed search.
acceptanceCriteria: On browsers where speech recognition is unavailable, the app does not throw runtime errors when rendering the search bar.
Typed search continues to work exactly as before when voice search is unavailable.
Any new user-visible fallback text introduced for unsupported browsers is English-only (no new Tamil-first copy added as part of this feature).

requirements.text: Ensure voice search integrates cleanly with existing search UI behaviors (debounced preview matching on Home page and navigation to /search) and does not introduce new authentication, booking, payment, or in-app chat functionality.

quotes:
No login required.
Works on mobile browsers.

acceptanceCriteria: Voice search does not require Internet Identity login and does not call any admin-only APIs.
After voice recognition, the existing Home page instant preview updates based on the filled text (via the existing state + debounced matching).
No new booking/payment/chat flows are introduced as part of voice search.

constraints: Use only the existing frontend stack (React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query); do not introduce external speech-to-text services or APIs.
Keep all new user-facing text (if any) in English for this change request.
Do not edit immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing components instead).
nonGoals: Adding server-side speech recognition or storing voice recordings on the backend.
Adding a language switcher UI specifically for voice search.
Changing the existing search relevance algorithm or taxonomy beyond feeding it the recognized text.
